name: capture-wake
description: Wake Island co-op with a human client and a long pregame, for packet-capturing a real client's join (features/udp-sidecar). Modest bots so the server loads fast and leaves room for the client; the 90 s pregame lets the capture start and the client connect before the round.
human: Join as soon as the capture is running and the join line is given: `~/.wine/bf1942-monitor/collector/bf1942-monitor.sh +joinServer 192.168.1.226:14568 +isInternet 0`. Spawn, move a little, then leave. The capture holds the handshake and the join events either way.
